title: Mist-Things
hook: Player-safe note: Mist-things move as half-seen animal shapes in low fog: not quite threat, not quite guide, but very sure they were here first.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Give one concrete visual, one sound or texture, and one sign of who has used or neglected it.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Mist-things move as half-seen animal shapes in low fog: not quite threat, not quite guide, but very sure they were here first.; show instinct first through distance, posture, scent, and how the creature protects what is close to it.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Open Vale™ Ritual Site, The Miremist, Forgotten Gods by noise and haste.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
